text:
maya: Quick proposal  run a 3-week partner sequence with CloudLane: short microblog posts + a gated technical webinar to generate integration-ready MQLs. Targets: ~200 MQLs, 40 demo requests, route some to CloudLane co-sell. Thoughts? :sparkles:

liam: love it. let's lock attribution before we publish. I suggest 70/30 split on joint leads, partner gets SFDC partner owner tag but Redwood SDRs get immediate triage. :+1:

maya: routing idea: all form submissions -> SFDC lead with partner=CloudLane, push to both queues (redwood_sdr, cloudlane_sales). Redwood does quick qual then hands to partner for deep tech follow.

liam: ops needs a UTM pattern for tracking.

maya: use this canonical utm: https://redwood.example/partners/cloudlane?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=microblog&utm_campaign=cloudlane_series_v1&utm_content=webinar_signup

sara: Blog plan 1010 short pieces (300-500 words) 1) mini-case w/ metrics, 2) how-to integration guide, 3) small benchmark highlight (latency/cost delta), 4) ops playbook for platform teams. I'll draft headlines + 2 A/B variants each.

oscar: Landing form: partner wants full name/company/email/role + opt-in checkbox to share with CloudLane. Need HubSpot->SFDC mappings. Ops: set lead_source=cloudlane_microseries, partner_optin=true.

oscar: routing pseudocode for ops:
```
if lead.lead_source == 'cloudlane_microseries':
  lead.partner = 'CloudLane'
  push_to_queue('redwood_sdr')
  push_to_queue('cloudlane_sales')
  tag('utm_campaign','cloudlane_series_v1')
```

jess: Webinar format: 15m product + 15m partner case + 10m demo + 20m Q/A. Who provides demo env? CloudLane said they'd host the live demo.

paul: Confirmed CloudLane will provide a customer speaker and demo environment. I'll get names + slide contributions by EOD Thur. Rehearsal Fri 11am PT.

nate: Let's A/B test landing page headlines (50/50). Add form param variant=A/B. Also record CTR and conversion by variant.

maya: Good call. Sara pls prepare 2 headline options per blog + 2 webinar title variants and 3 email subject lines. Example subjects: 1) "See how Acme cut LLM inference cost 3x with Redwood + CloudLane" 2) "Live: building low-latency inference at scale (real case)" 3) "Redwood x CloudLane: production integration walkthrough  register now"

sara: On it. Will share copy tomorrow morning for review.

liam: Add a hidden form field partner_campaign_id to avoid UTM stripping. Ops-bot can we automate mapping to SFDC.custom_partner_campaign?

ops-bot: Task created KL-7021: add hidden partner_campaign_id to CloudLane landing form and map to SFDC.custom_partner_campaign. Due in 3 days. <https://tasks.internal/KL-7021> :white_check_mark:

maya: Proposed timeline: week 1 = blog drafts + landing page live; week 2 = email invites + rehearsal; week 3 = webinar + post-webinar nurture + recording to attendees. I'll assign tasks in the doc.

paul: :thumbsup: locking rehearsal Fri 11am PT. Will cc partner after speaker confirmation.

jess: I'll handle platform, recording, RTMP test and produce slide template.

maya: Next steps: Sara (copy + A/B variants), Paul (confirm partner + speaker), Ops (form mapping + hidden id), Jess (logistics). Sync Wed standup. :rocket:
